description: Register a protocol's contracts and events for decoding (POST /v1/protocols/register). Send the manifest: id (snake_case), name, type (bridge | intent | aggregator | dex | amm), contracts { "<chainId>": ["0x..."] }, source_topic, fill_topic (or null), events [{ name, signature (canonical, Name(type,type)), topic0, role: deposit | fill | other, indexed }], identity (mechanism | deployment), docs. Every check the manifest allows is made (topic0 = keccak256 of the signature, 20-byte addresses, chains the superroot commits with their tier, no generic topic, no clash with a decoded protocol); problems come back as sentences. dry_run: true checks and keeps nothing. Without it a manifest that passes is kept as pending for the operator who lands it in the producer, and the answer carries the fragments and `does`: what is proven, attributed and decoded for it today. Proofs never need registration. Free.

contracts.description: chain id to list of 0x addresses
